
# Favicon Builder

> Favicon Builder is a browser-based tool for creating favicon and
> app icon packages from a user-provided image.

## Website

- Homepage: https://favicon.nvo987.us/
- Project owner: Nicholas Van-Orton
- Brand: NVO987
- Language: English
- Contact: nvo@nv987.us

## Purpose

Favicon Builder helps website owners create a collection of common
browser, mobile, and web application icons from a single image.

## Features

- PNG, JPEG, SVG, and WebP image input, subject to browser support.
- Drag-and-drop image selection.
- Multi-size PNG generation.
- ICO favicon generation.
- SVG favicon generation.
- Apple Touch Icons.
- Android and maskable icons.
- Web app manifests.
- Microsoft tile assets.
- Open Graph preview image.
- HTML integration snippet.
- ZIP package download.

## Privacy

Source images are intended to be processed in the user's browser.
The application loads JSZip from a third-party CDN.

## Usage

1. Visit the homepage.
2. Select or drop an image.
3. Generate the icon package.
4. Extract the downloaded archive.
5. Install the files in the target website's public directory.
6. Verify the generated paths and manifest configuration.

## Technical Details

The application uses HTML, CSS, JavaScript, HTML Canvas, and JSZip.
Generated assets should be tested against the target browsers and devices.
